params.name: id
params.description: A unique Project identifier. It can be a single id or multiple ids separated by a comma

params.name: from_time
params.description: Unix time stamp (epoch, in seconds) of Projects with `created_at` greater than or equal to the value.

params.name: to_time
params.description: Unix time stamp (epoch, in seconds) of Projects with `created_at` less than the value.

params.name: state
params.description: A project state (backlog, inProgress, inReview, inQA, done).

params.name: archived
params.description: A flag that toggles whether to include archived projects in the response (the default is `true`).

items.docs:
Retrieves one or more projects, including the documents associated with each project. Retrieving a project is the most efficient way to retrieve a single project, multiple projects or a list of all available projects.

Create a Project. A Project is a collection of Documents.

A Project is associated with exactly one Memory.

Projects appear in the dashboard of the web app.
